notes:
The page moves from global relative curves to formal curve elements along a distinguished section, then returns to a section associated with a K-rational point f_K of U_K. It writes the induced map in formula (29) and begins the statement that composing with a section of E_K over the rational-field Galois group, or over an open subgroup, gives another section. The sentence continues beyond this leaf; no conclusion has been supplied. The formal section identities were checked by reader A as recorded below. The classification implicit in première espèce and the existence of any arithmetic section are not proved here. The whole image and both supplied full-resolution halves were read once against both witnesses, including all agreed words and formula labels; twenty unique crops were then inspected, without recropping any place. The base is B. Globales has one visible underline. The first paragraph’s word at the right edge is transcribed as \unsure{distingu|disting}: the final low return may begin u or belong to g. Neither an unseen é nor an additional e is supplied, and no illegibility marker is added for missing paper. Dans is heavily retraced but has no separately established deletion or recoverable earlier wording. The noncontracted de une is retained. Associée is resolved at medium confidence from the two small ending elements; rationnel/rationnelle remains open. The small K forms throughout this leaf have a joined, n-like return: direct comparison of E_{U_K} with E_K on the same line, and of f_K/U_K with the explicit standalone K in sur K, supports K locally. They were not changed to eta merely because the latest notation table records an eta-like form elsewhere. The word tant remains uncertain in deletion state. The de after section is retained live: the vertical touching it belongs to the f descender of relatif above, and the dark horizontal is not independently distinguishable from the d-e join. The prefix in (29) now favors (f_K)_* while retaining E f_K|f_K; the section label favors g_i while retaining g; tt|tte remains doubtful. Formula (29) definitely has ψ on the right of the equals sign, a colon, and an ordinary right arrow. Its smaller interlinear placement is certain, but no leader uniquely fixes its linear attachment: C’s anchor before définit is provisional. Γ′ is a genuine insertion attached by a curved leader to the gap after ouvert; the leader is not an opening parenthesis. No comma is supplied after Γ_Q, and plutôt is absent. There are nineteen principal body baselines, one interlinear formula line including its number, one separate Γ′ insertion line, and one foliation line: twenty-two source lines under the inclusive count. There is no separate author page number at the head, and no drawing or standalone diagram. Source line division is reflected in the TeX; the mechanical break in élémentaire is recorded in a comment, and the compound hyphen of sous-groupe is retained. Double quotation marks, dash encoding, Q font choices and editorial alternative separators are handled as macro/editorial differences where they do not change a reading. H’s final note about another use of (29) is editorial, is not transcribed, and was not checked against any other leaf. Main reader independently reviewed both formal calculations: functoriality preserves the identity of the structure-map composite, and the displayed composition identity is valid also after pullback to the open subgroup. These checks provide no reason to complete the clipped word or regularise the uncertain formula prefix.

Blind adjudication restores a separate comma after the first pour, verified in a broader root crop so it cannot be confused with the following d of des. The section label now favors g_i but retains g. The clipped word is distinguished only through distingu|disting; no unseen ending is supplied. Pouvait|pourrait remains tense-uncertain from the flattened middle. The crowded formula prefix now favors (f_K)_*, retaining E f_K|f_K; its label and insertion placement remain. All small indices retain K after comparison with the same-line full-size K and the distinct eta control on leaf102. The paired-t abbreviation remains tt|tte. check_events.outcome: Conditional pointed-functoriality check: if u:U_K→Spec K is the structure morphism and f_K:Spec K→U_K is the stated K-rational point, then u∘f_K=id. For compatible geometric base points, applying the fundamental-group functor gives u_*∘(f_K)_*=id_{E_K}; thus the displayed arrow E_K→E_{U_K} has the section direction. Without fixed base points the usual conjugacy qualification remains. This checks the formal consequence of the assumed rational point, not the assertion that an arbitrary section of première espèce comes from one, and it does not resolve the crowded initial prefix by mathematical expectation.

check_events.outcome: Conditional group calculation: let p:E_{U_K}→E_K and r:E_K→Γ_Q be continuous homomorphisms, with pψ=id_{E_K}. If s:Γ_Q→E_K satisfies rs=id, then (rp)(ψs)=r(pψ)s=rs=id, so ψs is a continuous section of rp. For an open subgroup j:Γ′↪Γ_Q and s:Γ′→E_K with rs=j, the same calculation gives (rp)(ψs)=j; hence ψs lands in the pullback over Γ′ and supplies its section. This verifies the formal mechanism suggested by the unfinished final sentence, without asserting the existence of s or a particular continuation of the manuscript.
